$description: Semantic tokens: what components and the app use. Light theme only for now; dark becomes a second mode of these same tokens (ADR 0014).

subtle.$description: Quiet areas such as the fact box.

subtle-hover.$description: Hover on subtle areas, such as the secondary button.

inverse.$description: The dark header block on panels.

backdrop.$description: Behind a dialog: deep teal at half opacity.

link.$description: Inline links. At least 5.1:1 on every background: white, pale teal and the ocean.

on-inverse-muted.$description: Secondary text on the dark header block.

control.$description: Around inputs. Reaches 3:1 against white (WCAG 1.4.11), unlike the default border.

error.$description: Around an input with an error.

default.$description: Buttons and links. White text on it reaches 4.5:1.

hover.$description: One step darker than the accent: white on it reaches 6.5:1.

selected.$description: Told apart from written by its label (white, bold, larger), not by 3:1 contrast: Thor found the darker teal that reached it too dark (DESIGN.md). Reaches 3:1 against land and ocean.

fill.$description: The soft fill of duotone icons (docs/design/icons.md). A surface can set its own, such as a lighter teal on teal buttons.

control.$description: The height of buttons and inputs with a mouse or trackpad, so they line up side by side.

control-touch.$description: The same on touch screens (pointer: coarse), where controls need more room to tap. @thorbde/ui/base.css swaps it in.

icon-sm.$description: Icons in small text and inside controls.

icon-lg.$description: Icons in tab bars and headings.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls. WCAG exempts them from contrast.
